meta.title: Human joint table for code-driven rigs
meta.convention: Each movement is the named anatomical motion measured from anatomical position (0). [min,max] are angles of that motion; negative min means motion past neutral in the opposite direction (e.g. elbow flexion min -5 = 5 deg hyperextension). Bilateral motions (lateral flexion, rotation, deviation) are per side.
meta.humerothoracic_note: Shoulder values are humerothoracic (arm vs trunk) and include scapular motion. Split with the scapulohumeral rhythm if the rig has a scapula/clavicle bone.
meta.status_values: compile-time label of the NUMBER only: verified = number read in a cited source; derived = arithmetic on cited numbers; unverified = not confirmed in a source read; null = no value. It says nothing about the statistic, the segment frame or use as a limit: see provenance (KA-BD-6, 2026-11-23)
meta.clinical_tier: clinical = normative reference values: means of passive goniometry (CDC) or textbook typical values (LUTT). Individuals routinely exceed them; they are plausibility references, not physical ceilings.
meta.functional_tier: functional = motion observed or required in the cited tasks and populations; a single-study value, not an envelope and never a limit.

provenance_fields.segment_frame: which segment relative to what (for example thorax relative to the lab)
provenance_fields.statistic: what the number is (mean, textbook value, task peak, excursion = max minus min)
provenance_fields.task: which task, when the value is task-bound
provenance_fields.active_passive: active / passive / not stated, and the instrument
provenance_fields.read_level: what was actually read: full text | abstract | web page | secondary | tertiary
provenance_fields.confidence: verified | derived | unverified | null (heuristic: no factual confidence). About the number as read, not its use as a limit
provenance_fields.gate_eligible: false everywhere: no value has a Board enforcement record (KA-BD-5). A validator may only warn on these values
provenance_fields.derivation: for derived values: the arithmetic and its inputs
provenance_fields.omitted: a field that does not apply is omitted (confidence is always present; null = heuristic, no factual confidence)

coupled_rules: Lumbopelvic rhythm in forward bending: lumbar-to-hip ratio 1.9 (0-30 deg), 0.9 (30-60), 0.4 (60-90) [ESOLA1996].

Lateral bending and axial rotation are coupled; lumbar direction inconsistent, do not hard-code [LIEBSCH2025].

coupled_rules: Scapulohumeral rhythm ~2:1 glenohumeral:scapular after a ~30 deg setting phase [INMAN_via_OUHSC][OUHSC_SCAP].
In vivo ratio 2.3 raising, 2.7 lowering; scapula upward-rotates ~0.43 deg per deg of GH elevation [BRAMAN2009].
Posterior tilt and upward rotation increase to max elevation; scapula internally rotates up to ~125 deg GH elevation then externally [BRAMAN2009].
Validator band (heuristic): if humerothoracic elevation E > 30, scapular upward rotation in [(E-30)/3.5, (E-30)/1.5].
